verdict.rationale: Polar's docs say the docs site serves versioned, machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1.0 specs (2026-04.openapi.json and 2026-10.openapi.json, titled "Polar HTTP and Webhooks API"), alongside llms.txt and .md page siblings. The probe's 404s were only at guessed root paths (polar.sh/openapi.json and similar), not the documented docs-site location, so they do not concretely contradict the claim. missing for 10: independent or hands-on confirmation that the spec files download successfully, explicit full download URLs in the evidence.
